bagPolicy.summary: Only handbags up to 21cm x 30cm x 10cm (A4 size) are allowed. Backpacks, luggage and other large bags are not.
bagPolicy.note: If you cannot meet the size limit for medical reasons, contact the venue in advance.

parking.summary: The venue describes nearby public and reservable parking; review current neighbourhood parking restrictions.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Taxis can drop you off at the venue's door. After the event, use the taxi stand opposite the venue on d'Huartstraat.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: On-site food and beverage purchases use cashless payment.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair users and companions have reserved seating, and visitors may register accessibility needs before attending.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: If a show is not sold out, the box office can sell tickets before it begins.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Present your own ticket at the entrance for scanning, preferably saved on your phone in advance.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
